description: This file defines types, functions, and utilities for managing ACP (Agent Communication Protocol) binding configurations, including normalization, hashing, session key building, and record resolution.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns undefined if input is not a string.

methods.name: normalizeMode
methods.description: Normalizes input to either 'oneshot' or 'persistent' mode.

methods.name: normalizeBindingConfig
methods.description: Normalizes raw binding configuration object into a structured shape.

methods.name: buildBindingHash
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash based on channel, accountId, and conversationId.

methods.name: buildConfiguredAcpSessionKey
methods.description: Builds a session key string for an ACP binding based on its spec.

methods.name: toConfiguredAcpBindingRecord
methods.description: Converts a binding spec into a session binding record.

methods.name: parseConfiguredAcpSessionKey
methods.description: Parses a session key string to extract channel and accountId.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredAcpBindingSpecFromRecord
methods.description: Resolves a binding spec from a session binding record.

methods.name: toResolvedConfiguredAcpBinding
methods.description: Resolves a full binding object from a session binding record.
